say:1:1720949001:1.text: Wow... this paper is spending an unbelievable amount of money every month!
say:1:1720949001:1.source_cn: 哇……他们报社，每个月居然有这么多钱可以花！

say:3:1720949002:1.text: And I'd bet a good chunk of it never ended up where it was supposed to!
say:3:1720949002:1.source_cn: 哼，花得多，进自己口袋的也不少啊。

say:4:1720949003:1.text: Look at this. Five thousand gold for "property maintenance"? What, is the roof made of gold? That's not a real expense. That's someone skimming money and not even trying very hard to hide it.
say:4:1720949003:1.source_cn: 你看这笔场地维护费，5000金币？他家屋顶是金子做的吗...

say:5:1720949004:1.text: And this part's even stranger. Why is emergency funding for public works mixed in with the newspaper's expenses?
say:5:1720949004:1.source_cn: 还有这笔市政工程紧急款……为什么会和报社的支出混在一起？

say:6:1720949005:1.text: Because Viscount Demit clearly doesn't separate the two. He's treating the paper's accounts like his own private purse. Apparently even planks and rope can cost five thousand gold if he's the one signing off on it...
say:6:1720949005:1.source_cn: 看起来德米特子爵完全把报社账户当成自己的私人账户了，购...

say:7:1720949006:1.text: Compared to that, our paper almost feels kind of charming in how broke it is...
say:7:1720949006:1.source_cn: 这样相比起来，我们报社还真是寒酸啊……
